operators.name: relu6_forward
semantics: Preserves input shape, strides, and dtype.
Supports arbitrary stride layout; implementation must handle non-contiguous tensors correctly.

operators.name: sum_dim1_forward
semantics: Computes sum over dimension 1 (channels), keeping dimension: torch.sum(x, dim=1, keepdim=True).
For each batch b, height h, width w, output[b,0,h,w] = sum_c x[b,c,h,w].
Supports arbitrary stride layout; implementation must handle non-contiguous tensors correctly.

operators.name: expand_forward
semantics: Expands the second dimension from size 1 to out_features, replicating data along that dimension.
Output shape is [B, out_features, H, W].
The returned tensor may have stride 0 on dimension 1 to avoid data copy (as seen in reference output stride [H*W, 0, W, 1]).
Implementation should return a view with stride 0 on the expanded dimension if possible, but a real copy is also acceptable as long as shape and values match.
Input and output are float32 CUDA tensors with shape [16,3,2560,2560].
Sums over channel dimension (dim=1), keeping a singleton dimension.
Replicates the channel dimension to out_features=64.
